# MicrogliaMorphologyR

**Created**: 26 June, 2023  
**Last updated**: 01 Oct, 2026

## Welcome to MicrogliaMorphologyR!

MicrogliaMorphologyR is an R package for microglia morphology analysis,
that is complimentary to ImageJ macro
[MicrogliaMorphology](https://github.com/ciernialab/MicrogliaMorphology).
Using MicrogliaMorphologyR, you can perform exploratory data analysis
and visualization of different morphology features, characterize
morphological cluster identities, quantify shifts in morphological
populations, generate heatmap and boxplot visualizations of data in
flexible ways including at the single-cell level, animal-level, and
experimental condition-level, and perform statistical analysis of your
data.

For the MicrogliaMorphology Pipeline 2 workflow, see the [Pipeline 2
tutorial](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/articles/MicrogliaMorphologyPipeline2.html).

### If you are using this tool, please cite the following publication:

- [Development of a high-throughput pipeline to characterize microglia
  morphological states at a single-cell
  resolution](https://www.eneuro.org/content/11/7/ENEURO.0014-24.2024)

> Kim J, Pavlidis P, Ciernia AV. Development of a High-Throughput
> Pipeline to Characterize Microglia Morphological States at a
> Single-Cell Resolution. eNeuro. 2024 Jul 30;11(7):ENEURO.0014-24.2024.
> doi: 10.1523/ENEURO.0014-24.2024. PMID: 39029952; PMCID: PMC11289588.

## How to install MicrogliaMorphologyR

``` r

# install devtools package and make sure you have the latest version
install.packages("devtools")

# install MicrogliaMorphologyR using devtools
devtools::install_github('ciernialab/MicrogliaMorphologyR')
```

## How to use MicrogliaMorphologyR

Visit the [package
website](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/articles/MicrogliaMorphologyR.html)
for a tutorial on how to use MicrogliaMorphologyR using an example
dataset that comes with the package.

## Microglia morphology

Microglia exhibit a dynamic range of morphologies that are
context-specific and often rapidly changing in response to environmental
cues. While microglia more realistically exist along a continuous
spectrum of morphology, we can categorize them by their most commonly
observed forms to study microglia morphology. Here, we highlight the
four most commonly studied morphological classes, but others have also
been characterized including hyper-ramified, dystrophic, satellite, etc.
MicrogliaMorphologyR can also be used to characterize additional
morphologies beyond these four.

![](./reference/figures/GithubIntro_MicrogliaMorphologies.png)

- **Ameboid** = round, few processes
- **Hypertrophic** = thicker, shorter processes with larger soma
- **Rod-like** = elongated soma with bipolar processes
- **Ramified** = smaller soma with long, highly branched processes

Here are some recent and relevant reviews that you can read to gain more
background on microglia morphology and this project:

- [Microglial morphometric analysis: so many options, so little
  consistency (Reddaway et al.,
  2023)](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fninf.2023.1211188/full)
- [Microglia states and nomenclature: A field at its crossroads
  (Paolicelli et al.,
  2022)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9999291/)
- [Morphology of Microglia Across Contexts of Health and Disease (Savage
  et al.,
  2019)](https://link.springer.com/protocol/10.1007/978-1-4939-9658-2_2)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cell.level_boxplots()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/cell.level_boxplots.md)
  : Data visualization: individual morphology measures
- [`celldensity()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/celldensity.md)
  : Calculate microglia density
- [`clusterfeatures()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/clusterfeatures.md)
  : Cluster-specific average morphology measures
- [`clusterpercentage()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/clusterpercentage.md)
  : What are your morphology cluster percentages across variables of
  interest?
- [`clusterpercentage_boxplots()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/clusterpercentage_boxplots.md)
  : How do morphology cluster percentages vary across variables of
  interest?
- [`clusterplots()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/clusterplots.md)
  : Plot to show morphology clusters in PC space
- [`data_1xLPS_mouse`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/data_1xLPS_mouse.md)
  : 1xLPS mouse dataset
- [`data_2xLPS_mouse`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/data_2xLPS_mouse.md)
  : 2xLPS mouse dataset
- [`data_2xLPS_mouse_fuzzykmeans`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/data_2xLPS_mouse_fuzzykmeans.md)
  : 2xLPS fuzzy k-means soft clustering dataset
- [`data_ImageTypeComparison`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/data_ImageTypeComparison.md)
  : ImageTypeComparisons mouse dataset
- [`featurecorrelations()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/featurecorrelations.md)
  : Correlation heatmap across morphology features
- [`featurecorrelations_stats()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/featurecorrelations_stats.md)
  : Underlying stats for correlation heatmap across morphology features
- [`fraclac_tidying()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/fraclac_tidying.md)
  : Tidy up your FracLac output
- [`logscale()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/logscale.md)
  : Log scale
- [`merge_data()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/merge_data.md)
  : Merge FracLac and AnalyzeSkeleton results together into one final
  cell-level data frame
- [`metadata_columns()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/metadata_columns.md)
  : Tidy up metadata
- [`minmax()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/minmax.md)
  : Min-max scaling
- [`normalize_logplots()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/normalize_logplots.md)
  : Exploratory data analysis: normalization methods
- [`normalize_minmax()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/normalize_minmax.md)
  : Exploratory data analysis: min-max scaled plots
- [`normalize_scaled()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/normalize_scaled.md)
  : Exploratory data analysis: scaled plots
- [`outliers_boxplots()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/outliers_boxplots.md)
  : Exploratory data analysis: outlier detection
- [`outliers_distributions()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/outliers_distributions.md)
  : Exploratory data analysis: outlier detection
- [`pcadata()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/pcadata.md)
  : Dimensionality reduction using PCA
- [`pcadata_elbow()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/pcadata_elbow.md)
  : Dimensionality reduction using PCA and elbow/scree plot to get
  variance explained
- [`pcfeaturecorrelations()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/pcfeaturecorrelations.md)
  : What morphology features describe the PCs?
- [`pcfeaturecorrelations_stats()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/pcfeaturecorrelations_stats.md)
  : Underlying stats for correlation heatmap exploring which
  morphologies describe the PCs
- [`plots_expvariable()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/plots_expvariable.md)
  : Explore how experimental variables describe data
- [`samplesize()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/samplesize.md)
  : Sample size
- [`skeleton_tidying()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/skeleton_tidying.md)
  : Concatenate your individual AnalyzeSkeleton output files into one
  dataframe
- [`stats_cluster.animal()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/stats_cluster.animal.md)
  : Stats analysis: cluster-level changes
- [`stats_morphologymeasures.animal()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/stats_morphologymeasures.animal.md)
  : Stats analysis: individual morphology measures
- [`transform_log()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/transform_log.md)
  : Transform data: Log scale
- [`transform_minmax()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/transform_minmax.md)
  : Transform data: Min-max scaling
- [`transform_scale()`](https://ciernialab.github.io/MicrogliaMorphologyR/reference/transform_scale.md)
  : Transform data: Scaling
